arxiv-1810-01697.title: Jacob’s ladders and new synergetic formula generating infinite set of ζ \zeta -cooperative three-parametric invariants
arxiv-1810-01697.creator: Jan Moser
arxiv-1810-01697.description: Abstract . In this paper we obtain new ζ \zeta -synergetic formula namely an exact secondary complete hybrid formula. This one is generated by some set of trigonometric and power functions together with the square of module of the Riemann’s zeta-function on the critical line.

arxiv-2110-03633.title: Regression Markets and Application to Energy Forecasting
arxiv-2110-03633.creator: Pierre Pinson, Liyang Han, Jalal Kazempour .
arxiv-2110-03633.description: Abstract Energy forecasting has attracted enormous attention over the last few decades, with novel proposals related to the use of heterogeneous data sources, probabilistic forecasting, online learning, etc. A key aspect that emerged is that learning and forecasting may highly benefit from distributed data, though not only in the geographical sense.

arxiv-2202-02544.title: Rubio de Francia Extrapolation Theorems for Quasi-Monotone Functions
arxiv-2202-02544.creator: Arun Pal Singh, Rahul Panchal, Pankaj Jain, Monika Singh
arxiv-2202-02544.description: Abstract We prove Rubio de Francia extrapolation results in Lebesgue and grand Lebesgue spaces for quasi monotone functions with Q ​ B β , p QB_{\beta,p} weights. The extrapolation in Lebesgue spaces with the weight class Q ​ B β , ∞ QB_{\beta,\infty} has also been investigated.

arxiv-2202-03532.title: MINER: Multiscale Implicit Neural Representation
arxiv-2202-03532.creator: Vishwanath Saragadam, Jasper Tan, Guha Balakrishnan, Richard G. Baraniuk, Ashok Veeraraghavan
arxiv-2202-03532.description: Abstract We introduce a new neural signal model designed for efficient high-resolution representation of large-scale signals. The key innovation in our multiscale implicit neural representation (MINER) is an internal representation via a Laplacian pyramid, which provides a sparse multiscale decomposition of the signal that captures orthogonal parts of the signal across scales.

arxiv-2206-08124.title: Using adversarial images to improve outcomes of federated learning for non-IID data
arxiv-2206-08124.creator: Anastasiya Danilenka, Maria Ganzha, Marcin Paprzycki, Jacek Mańdziuk
arxiv-2206-08124.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Anastasiya Danilenka, Maria Ganzha, Marcin Paprzycki, Jacek Mańdziuk. One of the important problems in federated learning is how to deal with unbalanced data. This contribution introduces a novel technique designed to deal with label skewed non-IID data, using adversarial inputs, created by the I-FGSM method. Adversarial inputs guide the training process and allow the Weighted Federated Averaging to give more importance to clients with “selected” local label distributions. Experimental results, gathered from image classification tasks, for MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets, are reported and analyzed.

arxiv-2208-02191.title: Correcting non-independent and non-identically distributed errors with surface codes
arxiv-2208-02191.creator: Konstantin Tiurev, Peter-Jan H. S. Derks, Joschka Roffe, Jens Eisert, Jan-Michael Reiner
arxiv-2208-02191.description: Abstract A common approach to studying the performance of quantum error correcting codes is to assume independent and identically distributed single-qubit errors. However, the available experimental data shows that realistic errors in modern multi-qubit devices are typically neither independent nor identical across qubits.

arxiv-2209-09003.title: Irreducibility of Some Nested Hilbert Schemes
arxiv-2209-09003.creator: Chandranandan Gangopadhyay, Parvez Rasul, Ronnie Sebastian
arxiv-2209-09003.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Chandranandan Gangopadhyay, Parvez Rasul, Ronnie Sebastian. Let S S be a smooth projective surface over ℂ \mathbb{C} . Let S [ n 1 , … , n k ] S^{[n_{1},\dots,n_{k}]} denote the nested Hilbert scheme which parametrizes zero-dimensional subschemes ξ n 1 ⊂ … ⊂ ξ n k \xi_{n_{1}}\subset\ldots\subset\xi_{n_{k}} where ξ i \xi_{i} is a closed subscheme of S S of length i i .

arxiv-2302-06934.title: Model based MIN/MAX override control of centrifugal compressor systems
arxiv-2302-06934.creator: Rico Schulze, Hendrik Richter
arxiv-2302-06934.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Rico Schulze, Hendrik Richter. We consider an application-oriented nonlinear control of centrifugal compressors. Industrial applications require the compressor system to adjust to variable process demands and to be restricted to the valid operation range (e.g. We modify a compressor model of Gravdahl and Egeland to account for characteristic features of industrial compressors and combine the framework of nonlinear output regulation via the internal model principle with MIN/MAX-override control in order to implement trajectory tracking between given state constraints.

arxiv-2408-06852.title: Analytic solutions for the motion of spinning particles near brane-world black hole
arxiv-2408-06852.creator: Yunlong Liu, Xiangdong Zhang
arxiv-2408-06852.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yunlong Liu, Xiangdong Zhang. The general motion of spinning test particles to the leading order approximation of spin in the brane-world spacetime is investigated. Analytical integrations for the equations of motion and linear shifts in orbital frequency are obtained. As a result, we found that both the nodal precession and the periastron precession become larger when the tidal charge b b of brane-world spacetime becomes smaller. For the periastron precession, the effect is further amplified as the spin increases.

arxiv-2409-17921.title: Integers that are sums of two cubes in the cyclotomic ℤ p \mathbb{Z}_{p} -extension Thanks: Author’s Orcid ID: 0000-0001-6946-1559
arxiv-2409-17921.creator: Anwesh Ray
arxiv-2409-17921.description: Abstract . Let n n be a cubefree natural number and p ≥ 5 p\geq 5 be a prime number. Assume that n n is not expressible as a sum of the form x 3 + y 3 x^{3}+y^{3} , where x , y ∈ ℚ x,y\in\mathbb{Q} .

arxiv-2501-18428.title: Convergence of a semi-explicit scheme for a one dimensional periodic nonlocal eikonal equation modeling dislocation dynamics Thanks: The authors thank the anonymous referees for comments and corrections that helped us to improve this paper substantially.
arxiv-2501-18428.creator: Diana Al Zareef, Ahmad El Hajj, Hassan Ibrahim, Antoine Zurek
arxiv-2501-18428.description: Abstract . In this paper, we derive a periodic model from a one dimensional nonlocal eikonal equation set on the full space modeling dislocation dynamics. Thanks to a gradient entropy estimate, we show that this periodic model converges toward the initial one when the period goes to infinity.

arxiv-2506-12511.title: Chimera states on m-directed hypergraphs
arxiv-2506-12511.creator: Rommel Tchinda Djeudjo, Timoteo Carletti, Hiroya Nakao, Riccardo Muolo
arxiv-2506-12511.description: Abstract Chimera states are synchronization patterns in which coherent and incoherent regions coexist in systems of identical oscillators. This elusive phenomenon has attracted a lot of interest and has been widely studied, revealing several types of chimeras. Most cases involve reciprocal pairwise couplings, where each oscillator exerts and receives the same interaction, modeled via networks.

arxiv-2511-06459.title: Uncertainty-Aware Dual-Ranking Strategy for Offline Data-Driven Multi-Objective Optimization
arxiv-2511-06459.creator: Huanbo Lyu, Daniel Herring, Shiqiao Zhou, Miqing Li, Zheming Zuo, Jelena Ninic, James Andrews, Fabian Spill, Shuo Wang*
arxiv-2511-06459.description: Abstract Offline data-driven Multi-Objective Optimization Problems (MOPs) rely on limited data from simulations, experiments, or sensors. This scarcity leads to high epistemic uncertainty in surrogate predictions. Conventional surrogate methods such as Kriging assume Gaussian distributions, which can yield suboptimal results when the assumptions fail.

pmc-11432689.title: Cholesterol-Dependent Serotonin Insertion Controlled by Gangliosides in Model Lipid Membranes
pmc-11432689.creator: Jacques Fantini, Fodil Azzaz, Ryad Bennaï, Nouara Yahi, Henri Chahinian, Elek Molnár
pmc-11432689.description: Serotonin is distinct among synaptic neurotransmitters because it is amphipathic and released from synaptic vesicles at concentrations superior to its water solubility limit (270 mM in synaptic vesicles for a solubility limit of 110 mM). Hence, serotonin is mostly aggregated in the synaptic cleft, due to extensive aromatic stacking.

pmc-11547422.title: Evaluation of the Applicability of Waste Rubber in Insulation Panels with Regard to Its Grain Size and Panel Thickness
pmc-11547422.creator: Zdravko Cimbola, Anđelko Crnoja, Ivana Barišić, Ivanka Netinger Grubeša, Aleksander Hejna
pmc-11547422.description: This paper explores the effect of waste rubber grain size on the porosity, modulus of elasticity, thermal properties, and soundproofing performance of polymer composites with different thicknesses (10, 15, and 20 mm). All properties were tested in accordance with European standards, with the exception of porosity, which was measured using Archimedes’ principle.

pmc-12357347.title: Association between dietary intake, anthropometric indices, and diabetes-related foot ulcers in Type 2 diabetes: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12357347.creator: Moharam Jalalzadeh, Ensieh Nasli-Esfahani, Amirmasoud Mehrabani, Faezeh Geravand, Mohsen Montazer, Mohammad Heidari Seyedmahalle, Leila Azadbakht
pmc-12357347.description: AimsThis study explored the association of lifestyle factors and dietary status with foot ulcers and new anthropometric indices in individuals living with diabetes-related foot ulcers.MethodsIn this study, 339 patients with type 2 diabetes were recruited from the Diabetes Research Center of the Tehran University of Medical Sciences using a convenience sampling method.

pmc-12473418.title: Eco-Friendly Synthesis of Silver–Cellulose Nanocomposite Adsorbent from Agricultural Residues for Binary Dye System Remediation
pmc-12473418.creator: Doaa S. Al-Raimi, Reem M. Alghanmi, Ghalia S. Aljeddani, Ragaa A. Hamouda
pmc-12473418.description: This work reports a one-step, green synthesis of silver-micro cellulose nanocomposite (Ag@Ce NCs) using Azadirachta indica A. Juss leaf extract to load micro-cellulose isolated from peanut shells with silver nanoparticles, followed by comprehensive physicochemical characterization (FTIR, TEM, EDX-SEM, zeta potential, and XRD). The composite has pHPZC ≈ 5.

pmc-12691632.title: Second-generation lysocins as therapeutics for treating Pseudomonas aeruginosa infections
pmc-12691632.creator: Ryan D. Heselpoth, Chad W. Euler, Vincent A. Fischetti
pmc-12691632.description: Pseudomonas aeruginosa is a leading cause of nosocomial infections, including pneumonia and urinary tract infections, and the primary cause of morbidity and mortality in cystic fibrosis patients. The emergence of multidrug-resistant strains makes these infections life-threatening. To overcome this challenge, lysocins can be employed as novel antipseudomonals.

pmc-13096340.title: A dataset of soundscapes from Polynesian altiphotic, mesophotic and rariphotic zones
pmc-13096340.creator: Xavier Raick
pmc-13096340.description: Tropical coral reefs encompass diverse acoustic environments, yet knowledge of their soundscapes beyond shallow altiphotic reefs remains limited. This dataset provides comprehensive underwater recordings from altiphotic reefs, mesophotic coral ecosystems (MCEs), and the rariphotic zone in French Polynesia, collected across multiple islands, depths, and temporal scales.
